title: Brand swap: one brief, two brand profiles
caption: The 01 launch-film brief, claims and scene plan rendered with Magnifito's brand.json on the left and a fictional second brand, Quillfern Studio, on the right: colours, typeface (Geist against Geist Mono), logo and icon colours all come from the brand profile. Both profiles pass a brand check first.
prompt: Use the magnifito-brand skill to show that one brief works for any brand. Take the 01-branded-promo launch film (brief, claims and the four brand-title scenes) and render it twice with HyperFrames: once with Magnifito's brand.json (magnifito/), once with a second, clearly fictional brand, Quillfern Studio (quillfern/): deep teal and amber, Geist Mono Medium from the repository's OFL fonts, a simple fern-quill SVG logo, its own tagline and a quillfern.example address. Check both brand profiles first (schema, WCAG contrast of the text and mark colours, font files, licences and Cyrillic coverage) and keep the reports. Then put the two films side by side with mgvideo multicam and label each half with its brand in Geist (labels.svg).
commands: mgvideo multicam work/magnifito.mp4 work/quillfern.mp4 --layout side-by-side -o work/side-by-side.mp4
ffmpeg -i work/side-by-side.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -an -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/brand-swap.mp4
credits: Geist and Geist Mono typefaces by Vercel, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (fonts/OFL-Geist.txt, quillfern/fonts/OFL-Geist.txt); Geist Mono Medium is the WOFF2 vendored in vendor/barty-motion-graphics
